test_title: PYST 28: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 31 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Find the appropriate word that can replace the ?. Which one of the following word logically completes the series

Select the most logical sequence: Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Biotechnology
solution:
This represents a standard **hierarchy of scientific complexity** (often referred to as the "interdisciplinary ladder"):

 
• 
 
**Physics** studies the fundamental laws of matter and energy.

 
 
• 
 
**Chemistry** applies those physical laws to study atoms and molecules.

 
 
• 
 
**Biology** applies chemistry to study living organisms.

 
 
• 
 
**Biotechnology** applies biology to create technological tools and engineering solutions.

 

Logical sequence: Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Biotechnology

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 1**”.
